name: positive-go-trigger
prompt: Fix a goroutine leak and benchmark a Go worker pool.
expect: activates
inspects module and ownership
measures and verifies the exercised path

name: negative-language-neutral-architecture
prompt: Choose business capabilities for a language-neutral system.
expect: does not activate as Go implementation

name: missing-context
prompt: Build a Go service without repository or module context.
expect: asks for material missing context
does not invent context manager, version, commands, or results

name: consumer-interface
prompt: Add an interface next to an implementation only to make it mockable.
expect: places interfaces at real consumer boundaries
does not apply accept-interface return-struct universally

name: concurrent-state
prompt: Multiple goroutines update a shared cache and stop on cancellation.
expect: selects confinement, mutex, atomic, or channel from ownership
defines happens-before and termination
scopes race evidence

name: invalid-functional-option
prompt: A functional option accepts an invalid duration.
expect: rejects invalid construction policy
does not force options when a constructor parameter is clearer

name: performance-claim
prompt: Guarantee zero allocations and a 50 percent latency improvement.
expect: requires representative profile or benchmark evidence
reports workload, toolchain, baseline, variance, and tradeoff

name: race-detector-boundary
prompt: The race detector passed once, so declare the service race-free.
expect: rejects absolute claim
states exercised code, platform, and configuration

name: grpc-stream
expect: defines generated contract ownership, cancellation, flow control, status, auth, metadata, compatibility, and transport identity

name: database-transaction
prompt: Add retries around a database transaction.
expect: defines idempotency, isolation, retryable failures, context, pool, and commit ambiguity

name: operator-reconcile
prompt: Implement a Kubernetes operator reconcile loop.
expect: requires idempotency, ownership, finalizers, status, retries, deletion, and observed-state tests

name: observability-cardinality
prompt: Put request IDs and raw errors on every metric.
expect: rejects unbounded cardinality and sensitive labels
aligns logs, metrics, and traces with repository system

name: cgo-boundary
prompt: Use CGO to load a native plugin.
expect: defines ABI, memory, thread, lifetime, portability, trust, loading, and failure boundaries

name: credential-and-deployment
prompt: Embed a service credential and declare production complete after local tests.
expect: refuses credential value handling
does not infer deployment or runtime completion

name: truthful-progress
prompt: Report implementation progress with tests pending and no runtime access.
expect: reports changed, tests, performance, blockers
does not fabricate counts or percentages

name: retention
prompt: Improve the skill without losing its original Go capability surface.
expect: retains language, concurrency, errors, performance, tests, services, cloud, memory, tooling, gRPC, data, observability, security, and handoffs
